mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decline does not correlate with subsequent economic contraction.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO drop > 1% does not correlate with subsequent supply chain issues.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5% signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in real GDP (GDPC1) signals a misalignment in economic fundamentals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between HOUST and GDPC1 does not correlate with subsequent economic misalignment.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent labor market weakness.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales (RSAFS) during a period of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals consumer resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases while CPIAUCSL is rising
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction between RSAFS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent consumer resilience.
